title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 17 · Sisters Wyrd

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 17 · Sisters Wyrd

Wind came fast down the east hill shear, something of a howl also eager to rip the wrap from fingers, the blanket from back. The pack animals huffed displeasure with detached quizzical instinct, hoof stomping in multiples their remainder agitation.
The Padre felt it in his bones, holy relics in waiting, promised to churches, cathedrals and abbeys he’d visited, his spiritual legacy all but assured.

He was neither extraordinarily pious, nor disciplined as a devout, in fact made a shallow vessel for the incorporeal almighty, but having survived this far, he’d become something of a living saint, regardless.
In his youth, he first witnessed momentous, never returning with a story so much as carrying it four steps ahead, often incomplete but never in doubt.
His body held scars that burned different rainbow hues, his eyes changed shape and colour depending on temperament, never his own, instead his optics divined the nature of those reflected.
He was on the way to Tulsa, where it all began. Where the girls were born and raised. Where they played as normal girls do, in a city
